horoscope: You can experience some temperamentality if you’re feeling pulled in too many directions today, dear Aries. If you feel others have too much say in your life right now, you can become quite irritable. While you may tend to get easily offended or frustrated, tension can motivate you to make improvements. Still, there can be issues that stir up feelings of anxiety or possibly even guilt, and you might aim to do your best not to let these things interfere with your relationships. Arguments started now can reach a stalemate if both sides aren't willing to listen to the other. Temporarily, it may be hard to see the true value of people, situations, and material things, so waiting on big decisions or purchases might make sense.

You could feel somewhat torn between wanting to collaborate and preferring to stick with what's most comfortable and secure today, dear Taurus. As such, if you can manage it, a compromise makes sense. It can be a time to make adjustments and take steps to improve your situation. Relationship opportunities and fulfillment through partnerships are in focus, and this is only set to increase in the coming weeks. Fortunately, as the day advances, you could be feeling a stronger sense of purpose in your emotional and family life, and you can feel more motivation to work things through. Your instincts for success are strong right now.

You can experience a difference in values or disagreement about money today, dear Gemini, which can stir up some tension. You could be defending your values, your worth, or even your spending. Watch for a tendency to want to prove something, whether to yourself or others. Avoid pushing too hard for answers, as this can lead to undue stress. Venus forms an awkward aspect with Uranus in your sign, and it can be challenging to integrate your desire for personal independence with your need to attend to your duties or chores. Fortunately, as the day advances, it’s easier to resist distractions and get into a pleasant routine.

Bringing up your thoughts, ideas, plans, and passions may meet some reluctance or disapproval today, dear Cancer. Be kind to yourself, and avoid pushing something too hard. You may be taking things personally, and social discomfort could lead to overindulgent tendencies. You could feel edgy if you feel caged in or if people are trying to pin you down to an answer or a commitment. Take extra breaks or rest periods, if possible. It's time to shake things up, but do so in ways that don't rock the boat, as it isn't easy to get away with it right now. Recognize that you might be in reaction mode and aim to keep things real.

The day has a way of pulling your attention all over the place, dear Leo, and impatience with communications and secrets, in general, can be a theme. People can be a little prone to debate and sensitivity with opinions and beliefs. They might quickly jump on one another’s words or call people out. Pay attention to what pushes your buttons, since it can be revealing, but aim to stay patient and use restraint for the best results. As well, it's better not to mix business and pleasure today, as your heart can be in two places. While you want to feel safe and surround yourself with the familiar, something calls on you to move out of your comfort zone. Today may start indecisively, but good energy is with you to smooth things out as the day goes on. You're ready to make the most of a situation.

You could be distracted by challenging social problems today, dear Virgo. It’s a little too easy to get frustrated, particularly with pushiness, and people tend to be blunt and indelicate. Be sure to watch for communications that don't express what you truly feel. Also, you may be reading too much into what others are saying. You have loads of motivation to achieve and produce as the day advances, however. Enjoy the feelings of inspiration, and don't let impatience spoil things. Also consider that if you have too much on your plate, you may end up feeling quite hemmed in or restless.

The past has a way of pulling you in right now, dear Libra, especially when it comes to matters of the heart or of finances. It can be difficult knowing whether you need security and familiarity or excitement. Events right now tend to be a signal from the cosmos to get more rest, and also to prepare for busy days to come by letting go of attitudes that no longer serve you well. Venus and Uranus form an awkward angle, pitting your needs for comfort and security against your drive to discover or learn new things. Different settings or experiences can be most refreshing, although part of you can resist the urge to do something new. You may need to strike a compromise! Watch that your frustration with indecision doesn’t lead to jumping into something impulsively. Instead, aim to honor both your desire for a predictable pace and your need for a little more stimulation. Fortunately, you're more than willing to let go and enter a new phase.

It can be difficult to pursue what you want directly today, dear Scorpio, and it can also be challenging to relate in a healthy way to a partner. You may be more sensitive to others' reactions and comments, and may rebel as a result! Consider that you may be spending too much time reacting to your feelings instead of simply connecting with them. As well, watch for rushing a financial or intimate matter. You're curious and drawn to mentally engaging activities again today, but keep in mind that rushing through your tasks will more than likely lead to mistakes and disagreements. Even if mental energy isn't easy to channel constructively today, you may still feel optimistic. Commitment and dedication to your work or long-term goals can be strong, giving you a good sense of mission and something to work toward.

Part of you needs your space and time to get to your own conclusions today, dear Sagittarius, and another part would prefer to confer with someone special. With today's Venus-Uranus transit, and with different needs and drives competing for your attention, it’s not the best time for clarity. Impulsiveness with money, resources, or relationships can be a theme with today’s transits, but with awareness of this tendency, you have a better chance of keeping it under control. Remind yourself that a tug-of-war entered into today tends to have no winners. Fortunately, you’re focusing on moving on and improving, and with this attitude, you can put problems behind you.

You could be grappling with complex relationship dynamics today, dear Capricorn. You may feel divided, most likely around friends and acquaintances, work, or health. People could be a little withholding or detached, and you may not know where they stand. You may not be very clear on who or what to value today, so try to avoid behavior that may give you reason to regret it later, such as quick decisions in a relationship or impulsive spending. There can be a minor disconnect between your need for involvement and your desire to go your own way. However, as the day advances, you can be learning a tremendous amount about yourself, and self-honesty is at the heart of this.

Today's transits can be stirring up a bit of tension, dear Aquarius. It may be best to stay clear of power struggles and confrontations, as they seem to crop up all too quickly. Frustrations about schedules, duties, obligations, and lack of time to yourself can lead to interpersonal tension. It's possible you feel slighted today by friends or family, but you may be quite sensitive as well, and as a result, you may be reading the situation from a place of insecurity. Instead, there can be disagreements over values or concepts of love. If you feel overwhelmed, take steps to bring more balance to your life and ask for assistance. As the day advances, you might enjoy satisfying progress on projects dear to your heart, and the more meaning you find, the more dedicated you become.

There can be some defensiveness or misinterpretation of social cues with Venus in an awkward angle to Uranus today, dear Pisces. Before it spirals, consider whether or not it's better to drop something and move on. People may not be especially confident or reliable at the moment. Centering yourself now may be necessary to share yourself more freely and happily with others later. Mixed signals are hard to read in your relationships, and trying to find meaning in them or fill in the blanks may only complicate the problem. Money or boundaries could also be an issue. You may feel it’s best to stay out of it, but if something needs releasing, this can be a time for turning a corner. Try to ride things out and avoid blowing something out of proportion today.
